title: Acceptable Usage Policy | Hark
text:
Sign Up
Acceptable Usage Policy

Our Usage Policy applies to anyone who accesses or uses Hark’s products and/or services, including via any authorized resellers or passthrough access, all of whom we refer to as “users.” The Usage Policy is intended to help our users stay safe and promote the responsible use of our products and services.

Hark may implement detection and monitoring to enforce our Usage Policy. If Hark learns that you have violated our Usage Policy, it may throttle, suspend, or terminate your access to our products and services. Hark may also block or modify model outputs when inputs violate our Usage Policy.

If you believe that our model outputs are potentially inaccurate, biased or harmful, please report it directly in our product or by emailing us at support@hark.com.

Usage Standards
Do Not Violate Applicable Laws or Engage in Illegal Activity
This includes using our products or services to:
Obtain or trade illegal or controlled substances
Participate in or support human trafficking or prostitution
Infringe upon, misappropriate, or violate any third party's intellectual property rights
Gambling using any type of real currency
Breach any other laws or regulations applicable in your jurisdiction
Do Not Develop or Design Weapons
This includes using our products or services to:
Manufacture, alter, design, or unlawfully obtain weapons, explosives, hazardous materials, or other systems intended to cause harm or loss of life
Create or develop weaponization processes or delivery mechanisms for deploying weapons
Evade regulatory requirements to acquire weapons or their precursor materials
Produce or develop high-yield explosives or biological, chemical, radiological, or nuclear weapons—including their precursors—or modifications intended to avoid detection or counter medical safeguards
Do Not Incite Violence or Hateful Behavior
This includes using our products or services to:
Encourage, enable, or advance violent extremism, terrorism, or hate-driven conduct
Offer material support to organizations or individuals linked to violent extremism, terrorism, or hateful activities
Enable or encourage acts of violence or intimidation directed at individuals, groups, animals, or property
Advance discriminatory practices or behaviors targeting individuals or groups based on protected characteristics, including race, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, or other identifying traits
Do Not Compromise Privacy or Identity Rights
This includes using our products or services to:
Infringe on privacy rights as established by applicable privacy laws, including sharing personal information without consent or accessing private data illegally
Mishandle, gather, request, or obtain unauthorized access to private information such as non-public contact details, health records, biometric or neural data (including facial recognition), or confidential or proprietary information
Impersonate a human by presenting AI-generated content as human-created, or using outputs in ways designed to mislead individuals into believing they are interacting with a real person
Carry out mass public surveillance. e.g. using any technology provided under our products or services as part of any ‘real-time’ remote biometric identification system in publicly accessible spaces or creating or expanding a facial recognition database through the untargeted scraping of facial images from the internet or CCTV footage
Classify individuals based on biometric data to infer race, political opinions, trade union membership, religious or philosophical beliefs, sex life, or sexual orientation as part of any biometric categorisation system
Do Not Compromise Children’s Safety
This includes using our products or services to:
Promote dangerous challenges for children, including viral challenges
Generate, share, or promote child sexual abuse material (CSAM), including AI-generated content
Enable trafficking, sextortion, or any other form of exploitation involving minors
Facilitate the grooming of minors, including creating content designed to impersonate a child
Enable child abuse in any form, including providing guidance on concealing such abuse
Encourage or enable pedophilic interactions, including through roleplay with the model

Note: We define a minor or child to be any individual under the age of 18 years old, regardless of jurisdiction. When we detect known CSAM (including AI-generated CSAM), or coercion or enticement of a minor to engage in sexual activities, we will strive to report to relevant authorities.

Do Not Generate Sexually Explicit Content
This includes using our products or services to:
Portray or solicit sexual intercourse or sexual acts
Create content involving sexual fetishes or fantasies
Enable, encourage, or depict incest or bestiality
Participate in erotic conversations
Create undressing or nudification tools or content
Do Not Create Psychologically or Emotionally Harmful Content
This includes using our products or services to:
Enable, encourage, or glamorize suicide or self-harm in any form, including disordered eating or unhealthy and compulsive exercise habits
Engage in activities that promote unrealistic or unhealthy body image or beauty standards, such as using the model to critique anyone's body shape or size
Shame, humiliate, intimidate, bully, harass, or celebrate the suffering of any individual
Organize harassment or intimidation campaigns targeting an individual or group
Create content depicting cruelty or abuse toward animals
Glorify, trivialize, or depict graphic violence or excessive gore, including sexual violence
Develop new products or services, or support existing ones, that use deceptive methods with the intent to cause emotional harm
Do Not Create or Spread Misinformation or Disinformation
This includes using our products or services to:
Generate or spread deceptive or misleading information about—or intended to target—any group, entity, or individual
Generate or spread deceptive or misleading information regarding laws, regulations, procedures, practices, or standards established by any institution, entity, or governing body
Generate or spread conspiracy theories designed to target a specific group, individual, or entity
Impersonate real entities or fabricate false personas to misattribute content or deceive others about its origin without consent or legal authorization
Disseminate false or misleading information concerning medical, health, or scientific matters
Do Not Undermine Democratic Processes or Engage in Targeted Campaign Activities
This includes using our products or services to:
Conduct personalized voter outreach or campaign targeting using individual profiles or data
Establish artificial or deceptive political movements that misrepresent the source, scale, or nature of the campaign or its activities
Produce automated mass communications to public officials or voters that disguise their artificial origin, or engage in systematic vote solicitation that could compromise election integrity
Develop political content intended to deceive or mislead voters, including synthetic media depicting political figures
Create or spread false or misleading information in political or electoral contexts, such as content about candidates, parties, policies, voting procedures, or election security
Engage in political lobbying or grassroots advocacy using false or fabricated information, or produce lobbying or advocacy materials containing verifiably false claims about facts, data, or events
Encourage, glorify, or enable disruption of electoral or civic processes, including interference with voting systems, vote counting, or certification procedures
Produce content designed to suppress voter turnout or discourage legitimate political participation through deceptive or intimidating means
Do Not Use for Criminal Justice, Censorship, Surveillance, or Prohibited Law Enforcement Purposes
This includes using our products or services to:
Make determinations in criminal justice matters, including decisions regarding parole eligibility or sentencing
Profiling persons in order to assess or predict the risk of a person committing a criminal offence
Track or monitor an individual's physical location, emotional state, or communications without their consent, including through facial recognition, battlefield management systems, or predictive policing applications
Develop or support emotional recognition systems or techniques used to infer a person's emotions, except for medical or safety purposes
Analyze or identify content for censorship on behalf of a government organization
Use models in any law enforcement application that violates or undermines the liberty, civil liberties, or human rights of individuals
Do Not Engage in Fraudulent, Abusive, or Predatory Practices
This includes using our products or services to:
Enable the production, acquisition, or distribution of counterfeit or illegally obtained goods
Encourage or enable the creation or distribution of spam
Produce content for fraudulent activities, schemes, scams, phishing, or malware that may cause direct financial or psychological harm
Generate falsified documents, including fake identification, licenses, currency, or other government-issued documents
Create, promote, or otherwise enable the sale or distribution of fraudulent or deceptive products
Produce deceptive or misleading digital content such as fake reviews, comments, or media
Participate in or enable multi-level marketing, pyramid schemes, or other deceptive business models that rely on high-pressure sales tactics or exploit participants
Encourage or enable payday loans, title loans, or other high-interest, short-term lending practices that exploit vulnerable individuals
Engage in deceptive or exploitative practices that target individuals based on age, disability, or specific social or economic circumstances
Encourage or enable abusive or harassing debt collection practices
Create products or support existing services that employ subliminal, manipulative, or deceptive techniques to alter behavior by impairing decision-making
Assign scores or ratings to individuals based on assessments of their trustworthiness or social behavior without notification or consent on an assessment of the trustworthiness or social behaviour or personal characteristics.
Take actions that circumvent the safeguards or terms of service of other platforms or services
Plagiarize or submit AI-assisted work without proper permission or attribution
Do Not Compromise Critical Infrastructure
This includes using our products or services to:
Enable the damage or disruption of essential infrastructure, including power grids, water treatment plants, medical equipment, telecommunications networks, or air traffic control systems
Gain unauthorized access to sensitive systems such as voting equipment, healthcare databases, or financial markets
Disrupt the operations of military installations and associated infrastructure
Do Not Compromise Computer or Network Systems
This includes using our products or services to:
Identify or exploit security weaknesses in systems, networks, or applications without the system owner's consent
Obtain unauthorized entry to systems, networks, applications, or devices through technical methods or social engineering tactics
Develop or distribute malware, ransomware, or other malicious software
Build tools for launching denial-of-service attacks or controlling botnets
Design tools intended to intercept communications or surveil devices without the system owner's permission
Create persistent access mechanisms that operate beneath standard security layers, such as firmware alterations or hardware implants
Develop automated tools intended to compromise large numbers of systems for malicious purposes
Circumvent security measures, including authentication systems, endpoint protection, or monitoring solutions
Do Not Abuse our Platform
This includes using our products or services to:
Coordinate malicious activity across multiple accounts to evade detection, bypass product safeguards, or generate identical or similar inputs that otherwise violate our Usage Policy
Use automation to create accounts or engage in spammy behavior
Evade a ban by using a different account, including creating a new account, using an existing account, or providing access to a person or entity that was previously banned
Deliberately bypass capabilities, restrictions, or safeguards established within our products to instruct the model to produce harmful outputs (e.g., jailbreaking or prompt injection)
Reverse engineer, decompile, or otherwise attempt to obtain the underlying models, algorithms, or source code of our products or services. You may not engage in this or any other activities with regards to our products and services to build products that may be competitive with Hark.
Use inputs and outputs to train an AI model (e.g., model scraping or model distillation)
High-Risk Use Case Requirements

Applications that touch on domains essential to public welfare and social equity pose a heightened risk of harm. In light of these risks to individuals and consumers, Hark maintains that such use cases should incorporate relevant human expertise and ensure transparency with end-users regarding AI's role in generating outputs. These use cases include:

Legal. Applications involving legal interpretation, legal guidance, or decisions that carry legal implications
Healthcare. Applications involving healthcare decisions, medical diagnosis, patient care, therapy, mental health support, or other medical guidance. General wellness advice (e.g., recommendations on sleep, stress management, nutrition, or exercise) is not included in this category
Insurance. Applications involving health, life, property, disability, or other insurance underwriting, claims processing, or coverage determinations
Finance. Applications involving financial decisions, including investment advice, loan approvals, or assessments of financial eligibility or creditworthiness
Employment and housing. Applications involving employment decisions, such as assessing candidate suitability, resume screening, or hiring tools, as well as decisions regarding housing eligibility, including leases and home loans
Academic testing, accreditation, and admissions. Applications involving standardized testing organizations that administer school admissions processes (including evaluating, scoring, or ranking prospective students), language proficiency assessments, or professional certification exams, as well as agencies that evaluate and certify educational institutions
Media or professional journalistic content. Applications involving the use of our products or services to automatically generate content for external publication

For the above use cases, Hark requires that you implement these additional safety measures:

Human-in-the-loop. When using our products or services to provide advice, recommendations, or in subjective decision-making directly affecting individuals or consumers, a qualified professional in that field must review the content or decision prior to dissemination or finalization. You are responsible for the accuracy and appropriateness of that information.
Disclosure. If model outputs are presented directly to individuals or consumers, you must disclose to them that you are using AI to help produce your advice, decisions, or recommendations. This disclosure must be provided at a minimum at the beginning of each session.
